quests.title: Geri's Gastro-Nostalgia

dialogue.t: Yes, that's my commission. Have you already prepared three bowls of Radish Veggie Soup?
Mmm, smells good. Just like I remember it...
Thank you so much, these are for you. I'm going to enjoy every spoonful.

quests.description: Geri needs three bowls of Radish Veggie Soup.
